Singapore tech recruiters keep saying the same thing — and it isn't 'more Python.' 🎯

The candidates getting hired in 2026 stack three things: communication that lands, technical depth in one stack, and working fluency with AI tools. Each one alone gets you screened. All three gets you offered.
